name: Eclipse
summary: A black disc ringed by one glowing dot per band, with a corona that flares on the bass.
credit: After the Eclipse in Felix Turner's Uberviz (https://uberviz.io). No code used; written fresh.
hint: One dot per band round a black disc: lows at the bottom, highs at the top when mirrored. Loud dots swell and push out; the corona flares on the bass.

params.label: Disc
params.help: The black disc's radius, as a fraction of the ring.

params.label: Curve
params.help: Brightness is the level to this power: higher darkens quiet bands.
